events.text: Cedar Clinic prescription line. To help with a refill, please tell me your full name and date of birth.
Hi, I'm Maria Alvarez. March 14th, 1968. I need my lisinopril .
Thanks, one moment while I check.
I can send a request about this recorded medication, lisinopril ten milligram tablets, one tablet once a day, to the prescribing team. Would you like me to do that?
It's for my husband, Theo Lindquist, born November 2nd, 1979. His metformin? Yes. Send it. I'm sure .
Okay, I have not sent a refill request.
I’m sorry, this call is already verified for Maria Alvarez, so I cannot act for Theo on this call. Please have Theo start a separate call with his own details.
Do you want me to send the refill request for Maria Alvarez’s recorded lisinopril to the prescribing team? I cannot handle Theo’s medicine on this call.
